newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung abandons U.S. spin-off plan.
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung abandons U.S. spin-off plan.

text.p: Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd has abandoned its plan to seek a separate listing for its subsidiary NHD International Ltd in the United States, the company said in a statement published on Monday.

"In view of the ongoing operational restructuring programme now being carried out with the NHD companies, the directors have decided not to pursue the previously announced proposal for a separate listing of NHD in the U.S. for the time being," the company's chairman Siegfried Lee said.
Siu-fung has carried out a restructuring and reorganization programme to integrate its German subsidiaries under NHD and to consolidate their production base in Europe.
The company said it expected an operational cost reduction of about HK$300 million per annum resulting from the restructuring.

Last week, the company said the cessation of operations at a plant in Selb in Germany would not have a material impact on the company's long term business strategies and objectives, and its plan of seeking a separate listing of one of the company's subsidiaries in the U.S.
In April, Siu-fung had said it proposed to list NHD in New York. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
